from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

run='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v14';batch='resumed-low-v14-auto-2-20261025';commit='becd621be26859e8c6081fae51d7bf94bce47f44'

archive=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261026-v14-tail-network-failure'
for source,suffix in [(state_path,'-original-publisher-state.json'),(publication,'-original-publication.json')]:
 target=Path(str(archive)+suffix);assert not target.exists();target.write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
audit=Path(str(archive)+'.json');assert not audit.exists()
write_json(audit,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'run_id':run,'batch':batch,'commit':commit,'actual_publisher_exit_code':1,'original_deadline_utc':state['original_deadline_utc'],'preserved_originals':{p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix():file_sha256(p) for p in [Path(str(archive)+'-original-publisher-state.json'),Path(str(archive)+'-original-publication.json')]},'cause':'Ordinary fast-forward Git push connection reset; subsequent remote probe could not reach configured local proxy. p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-X','utf8',str(ROOT/'tools/production_checkpoint_publish.py'),commit,batch],cwd=ROOT,timeout=3600)
assert p.returncode==0,'Inspect preserved history before further retry'
pub=read_json(publication);proof=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/master-readback-{batch}.json')
assert pub['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified' and proof['status']=='verified' and proof['commit']==commit
assert read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json')['completed_source_requests']==39
target=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261026-v14-tail-publication-reconciled.json';assert not target.exists()
record={'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'run_id':run,'batch':batch,'fixed_commit':commit,'checkpoint_requests':39,'new_original_PNGs':state['checkpoints'][-1]['new_original_PNGs'],'actual_verified_readback':proof,'historical_failure':audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'historical_failure_sha256':file_sha256(audit),'original_deadline_utc_unchanged':state['original_deadline_utc'],'scope':'Immutable snapshot contains accumulated LOW output through following v15 early imports; 43 saved PNGs are snapshot count, not v14-only image return count. v14 had39calls37PNG2refusals. No image replay.','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')}
write_json(target,record)
state.update(status='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline',last_checkpoint_requests=39,last_completed_requests=39,last_commit=commit,finished_at_utc=utc_now(),tail_reconciliation=target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),tail_reconciliation_sha256=file_sha256(target));write_json(state_path,state)
print(json.dumps({'status':state['status'],'commit':commit,'new_original_PNGs':record['new_original_PNGs'],'verified_originals_this_execution':428+record['new_original_PNGs']}),flush=True)
